## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：记录详情页的汇总（summary）字段改用它自己的只读展示 `SummaryField` 绘制，长文本汇总完整显示并换行；`SummaryField` 文字颜色从写死的 `text-gray-700` 改为主题色 `text-foreground`。
- 为什么改：文本汇总此前在记录页只显示一行省略号，完整值只在悬停提示里；公式字段已在 #34148 修过，这是剩下的汇总一半。写死的灰色在暗色模式下不变。
- 风险与回滚：只影响记录详情页的汇总行和汇总字段只读展示；列表/表格行仍一行截断，高亮条不动，宿主自注册的 `summary` 展示保留。浅色模式下汇总文字会略深（灰 700 → 前景色）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx` 新增的 `summary` 分支（紧挨 `formula` 分支）；`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/SummaryField.tsx` 颜色类。
- 两分钟验证：打开带长文本汇总字段的记录，值完整换行显示；切暗色模式，汇总数字不发暗。
- 需要你做的：无，区内落地（非受管面、173 行）。L1 意见：改动小而准，钉子和消融齐全，可落。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-a) · repo:objectstack#5 · head `1459c2e1366dc6d61e9770a6cb286a91b5a9c624` · 2026-11-19T01:20Z

- **形态:** draft → `main`, 5 files, +164/−9, 2 commits. `Fixes #34182` on the first content line; no other card number beside a closing keyword in the body. `check-governed-merges --pr 35269`: 0 of 5 paths governed, 173 lines ≤ 3000 → ordinary queue landing. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/34182-summary-read-wraps.md`, patch for `@object-ui/plugin-detail` + `@object-ui/fields` (neither `private`, both published). Sentences read against the diff: "reads a summary through the summary field's own read display, the face the record form draws" (lazy registry maps `summary` → `SummaryField`); "a number or money roll-up reads the same text" (control pin `1,234.50`); "list and grid rows keep the one-line cell" (control pin on `FormulaCellRenderer` `truncate` + `title`); "a host's own `summary` face is kept" (control pin); "no metadata key, value or default changes" (true: no `packages/spec` path). No `content/docs/releases/` change, no unrelated file.
- **差异由 L1 读过:** `DetailSection.tsx` adds one branch `CellRenderer === FormulaCellRenderer && resolvedType === 'summary'` → `<SummaryField … dependentValues={data} readonly />`, same shape as the `formula` branch; comment block updated. `SummaryField.tsx` one class swap. Both test files existed on `main` (`git diff --summary`: only the changeset is a new file), new blocks appended as top-level `describe`s.
- **前提:** card `Blocked-by: #34148`; the `formula` branch it names is on `main` at merge base `cdb327fd`. Card asks: dark-mode colour on the read display, summary read through it on the record grid, grid row and highlights keep their faces, pins + control + ablation. All present.
- **Pins:** record page at 1440 px and phone width: the summary cell's `innerHTML` equals `SummaryField`'s markup, full text, no one-line class between text and cell, no `title`. Fields package: `text-foreground` present and no fixed `text-(gray|slate|zinc|neutral|stone)-N`, for a number and a text value. Ablation in PR body, two legs each `2 failed | 141 passed (143)`, restored by blob hash.
- **门禁:** check-runs on head `1459c2e1`: 44 success, 13 skipped, 0 failure. Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Lint UI, Type Check UI, Test UI (16/16 shards), Build & E2E UI, Check Changeset all `success`. Dev local `check:type-check-debt` NOT MEASURED; CI `Type Check · debt ledger` on this head is `success`, which covers it.
- **接受的偏差:** none beyond the mechanism note in the body (card says "the token the other read displays use"; those inherit and set none, so the PR uses `text-foreground`, the token the record row's value container sets). Accepted.
- **范围外去向:** `AutoNumberField`'s read display in the published `@object-ui/fields` also hard-codes `text-gray-700` with no `dark:` partner (dev read it in code, not touched here). Noticed-and-untouched published defect ⇒ a follow-up card is owed: ux-2 files it (p3, `area:ux`) before close-out of #34182 and puts its number in the close-out comment.
- **落地条款:** K = 3 first-parent commits on `main` since merge base `cdb327fd` (< 15), no new locale pack. Non-governed ⇒ ux-2 lands per `landing-operations.md` (`pr_ready` + auto-merge) after this ACCEPT; on MERGED, close-out on #34182 with the follow-up card number.
